drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Within 14 days after execution of this Agreement, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of USD 31,000,000, which amount is inclusive of any attorneys’ fees, costs, and expenses.
edits.name: Payment clause

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon payment of the Settlement Amount, each Party, on behalf of itself and its respective predecessors, successors, assigns, affiliates, agents, employees, officers, directors, insurers, and attorneys, fully and forever releases and discharges the other Party from any and all claims, demands, liabilities, rights, causes of action, damages, costs, and expenses of every kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters in dispute.
edits.name: Release clause

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, and the Parties shall not disclose them except as required by law or as necessary to effectuate this Agreement.
edits.name: Confidentiality clause

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or any other concession by any Party.
edits.name: No admission clause
